correctness.rationale: The repair proves minimal section dimension for unequal face lattices and replays the concrete three-dimensional witness. For ℓ>0 the coordinate-face height intervals are [0,N−a_i−ℓ] and [a_i+ℓ,N], and the link intervals are [a_i−ℓ,N−a_{i+1}+ℓ]. Bounds give the endpoints and 2ℓ≤min a_i ensures their explicit extremizers satisfy the other links; the extremizers are unique. Each original facet has relative interior, and produces a section facet exactly at strict intermediate heights. Distinct projected normals (or parallel coordinate planes with different offsets) prevent double-counting. Pairing the coordinate intervals and cyclically relabeling the link endpoints proves complementary facet counts by class even at wall heights. Thus dimension two has equal polygon side counts and dimension one consists of intervals; ℓ=0 is the box reflection case. For the witness, a separately written rational ambient-system solver, exact two-coordinate convex hulls and Jacobian factors recover seven coordinate and four link facets at each height, the two area totals, and 16 versus 15 vertices. Euler gives (16,25,11) and (15,24,11). Theorem 4.8 directly applies to its integer parameters and heights for Ehrhart equality. The area corollary is identified as prior implication, not relied on as a novelty assumption.
residual_risks: The minimal-dimension statement applies to interior complementary sections with the half-size link threshold, and concerns face-lattice isomorphism, not congruence, lattice-affine equivalence, or all height profiles.

broader_coverage.reasoning: Neither total combinatorics of the unsliced polytope nor volume of complementary slices resolves the face-lattice cutoff. What matters is which original faces and vertices the slice intersects at each complementary height.

value.rationale: The focused result identifies the first dimension where the geometry and combinatorics part company in this family. The witness has equal Ehrhart functions, equal total areas by facet class and even equal facet counts by class, yet distinct face vectors; the exact cutoff makes this more than an arbitrary numerical example. The distinction is between different cell-incidence types and merely different lengths or radii of the same face type.
residual_risks: No general classification of higher-dimensional complementary face vectors or face lattices is claimed.
